column1: # One row per physical source line that decides the shape of a user-supplied configuration value. Consecutive mechanisms on one line remain one row in execution order.
# The inventory follows input doors to consumers and includes option classes, configuration roots, inline directives, CLI adapters, composer input, and architecture sub-schemas.

# Scope contains 455 sites in 84 files: 447 USER_INPUT and 8 MEASURED_VALUE. Of the 440 sites outside RuleOptionsFactory, 205 are within the rule-option declaration boundary and 235 are explicit exclusions.

# Blind spots: PHP numeric widening, values inside computed-metric formulas, baseline documents, multi-line casts, Symfony Console parsing, and unnamed-key sites that require the companion resolution table.
# Reachability is explicit: typed withOverride inputs and empty-config branches may be unreachable through the factory even though direct calls can reach them.
# Columns: file, line, class, method, key, kind, input_kind, on_mismatch, reachable, in_factory, exception_candidate, reason, snippet.
